scope: Existing JavaScript boundaries, not full JSON Schema validation or native feasibility

results.finding: Native captureMethod is not accepted by PXP 1.0.
Contiguous ordinal set can pass in reverse array order; mapper preserves array order.
Manifest summarizes process IDs and omits per-step parameters and masks.
513 observed steps pass the JS provenance validator but fail manifest process capacity 512; schema step ceiling is 2048.
Exact payload duplicate is a no-op; changed payload under same manifest ID is conflict.
Direct mapper selects a supplied assetId even when resolutionState is UNRESOLVED.
JS validator permits an extra nested source field prohibited by JSON Schema.
Read model copies arbitrary parameter text; it is not a privacy sanitizer.
Read model accepts a projection without an explicit sidecar binding when acceptanceAuthority is false.
SUGGESTED is rejected as executed provenance.
Unavailable capture remains unavailable through mapper and read model.
Changing export identity and timestamp changes the digest even with identical workflow content.
